body: Azure Advisor is a personalized best-practice guide built into the Azure portal. It evaluates your Azure resources and recommends how to improve reliability, security, performance, operational excellence and cost. Each recommendation has an action you can take right away, postpone or dismiss, and you can set up notifications for new recommendations. The Advisor dashboard shows recommendations for all your subscriptions and can be filtered by subscription, resource group or service.
author: claude

body: Azure Service Health has three views, narrowing from global to one resource. Azure status gives a global picture of Azure health across all services and regions. Service Health shows outages, planned maintenance and health advisories relevant to the services you use, and you can set up alerts. Resource Health shows whether a specific resource, such as a virtual machine, is running normally, and whether a problem is on Azure's side or yours.
author: claude

body: Azure Monitor is a platform for collecting, analyzing and acting on data from Azure, on-premises and multicloud resources and applications. Log Analytics is the tool in the Azure portal for writing and running queries against the data Azure Monitor collects. Azure Monitor alerts notify you when a condition you define is met; an action group controls who is notified and what happens next.
author: claude

body: Application Insights is an Azure Monitor feature that monitors the performance and usage of web applications, whether they run in Azure, on-premises or another cloud. It can track request rates, response times, failure rates, dependency calls and page load times. It can also run availability tests that send synthetic requests so you know the app is responding, even when traffic is low.
author: claude
